{: .no_toc }

Edit, rotate or revoke a key.

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fields | settings rows | name, permissions, restrict_destructive (editable); scope, mode, intended_use, expires_at, created_by, last_used_at (read-only) |  | Adw*Rows |
| Rotate | button | POST /api-keys/{id}/rotate | confirm: no overlap | GtkButton |
| Revoke | destructive-button | DELETE /api-keys/{id} | confirm | GtkButton .destructive-action |
| Recent activity | list | audit events by this key |  | GtkListBox .boxed-list |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Save | `PATCH /api-keys/{id}` |  |
| Rotate | `POST …/rotate` | 200 → KEY-03 |
| Revoke | `DELETE /api-keys/{id}` | 204 → row shows Revoked |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /api-keys/{id}` · `GET /audit-events?actor_id={id}`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
